title: Decimillipede
move_pattern: Cycles through three attacks in order: Writhe → Constrict → Bulk. When killed, enters Dead state, then performs Reattach to heal and return to combat, followed by random selection from the three main attacks.
notes: Part of the Decimillipede multi-segment encounter. When multiple segments enter combat, each adjusts its max HP to a unique even value to prevent duplicates. Has a Reattach power (25 stacks) that manages respawning. All segments coordinate their attack animations together. Not shown in the compendium and won't fade after death.
